'''Levet's farm''' was a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], and owned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] known as [[Levet]].<ref name="Revelation" /> Located approximately ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] outside of Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]],<ref name="Location" /> Levet's farm was only a short distance down a simple dirt road from the [[Beviin-Vasur farm]]. One night, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[41 ABY]], a group of Mandalorians had gathered at Levet's farm for a celebration that carried well into the early morning [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Noise, [[Naasad'guur mhi – Mhi n'ulu|singing]], and laughter from the revelers could be heard for some distance away.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Levet's farm was first brought into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] with a mention in the [[2008]] novel, ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
